author: JandJSecurity
body:
I was banned about 2 months ago and I haven't been on minecraft in about 3. My friend LJ00 went onto my account while he was banned and got me banned. I don't know how he got on my account but I don't think I should have been banned. That's all. 


     Thanks-JandJSecurity

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello JandJSecurity,

Thank you for appealing and for your patience, I apologize for the wait. Unfortunately, as much as we appreciate your honesty, we cannot make exceptions as we must keep everything fair and consistent with punishments. 

Please make another appeal in 2-4 months as you have not reached the minimum amount of time to be considered to be appealed. Therefore, I am denying this appeal. A senior will review everything and lock the thread.

Thank you again for your patience and honesty.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez
